{{Dialogue|Ackbar|Though it was not part of the Rebel Alliance, Dornea has its own heroes from the fight against the Empire. General A'baht has a long and exemplary record as a fleet commander with the Dornean Navy. We are fortunate to be able to call upon his services.|Marook|The entire Dornean Navy numbers barely eighty vessels.|Organa Solo|And yet, the Dornean Navy successfully defended Dornea's independence throughout the reign of Palpatine, against Imperial forces several times as large.|attr=[[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], [[Cian Marook]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|src=<ref name="BTS" />}}
A '''war''' took place between the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dornea/Legends|Dornea]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the larger [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==History==
The war lasted for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], with the [[Dornean Navy]]&mdash;using a number of small [[Starship/Legends|vessels]]&mdash;holding back the much larger [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] until at least [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="DB" />

In 4 ABY, the Dornean [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] lent the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] two [[Braha'tok-class gunship/Legends|''Braha'tok''-class gunships]] for the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="DB" />
